name: Orla Dock
description:
A dock for GNOME Shell inspired by the macOS Dock.

• Wave magnification, Genie minimize effect and live window previews
• Folder stacks that open as a fan, grid or list, with drag and drop
• Dock and taskbar styles, chosen from a preview
• Taskbar Panel mode with tray, Quick Settings, clock and a Start Menu
• Orla Glass: adaptive frosted glass with refraction at the edge
• Touches the screen edge while a window is maximized
